title: The canonical map detects completeness
promptMarkdown: Prove that if the canonical isometry $J:X\to X^{**}$ is surjective, then $X$ is complete. Then explain, using $c_0$, why completeness alone does not imply surjectivity.
hintLadder: Which space is automatically Banach even if $X$ is not?
Transfer a Cauchy sequence through the isometry, then use surjectivity.

criteria.criterion: Establishes completeness of the double dual.
